status: Barycentric comparison contract adopted by decision 0001; corrected terrestrial fields/budgets are proposals; M0 pending central review.
encoding: All scientific scalar values are decimal strings. __float128 serialized with 36 significant digits and checked by exact strtoflt128 round trip. Integers and metadata flags compare exactly. Python comparisons use Decimal with 90-digit context.
identity: fixture + original_observations[index].line; retain input order, original decimal tokens, raw line, and input hashes

stages.parsed: immediately after readParfile/readTimfile, before optional preProcessSimple
stages.direct_initial: manual BAT=BBAT=SAT as upstream subtractBATs, then residuals
stages.perturbed: add exactly decimal 4e-9/86400 to all but first aligned SAT; recompute residuals
stages.offset_4ns: add 4ns to every original SAT, then formBatsAll

prefitResidual: Intentionally unavailable. t2Fit_getFitData copies residual into prefitResidual only when fitting begins; no fit is performed.
comparison_rationale: Same-build regeneration is exact. Decision 0001 adopts the stated barycentric absolute gates (epochs scaled to seconds), exact identities/flags/counts and relative parameter gate 1e-30 with exact zero. Terrestrial budgets remain proposals. These engineering gates do not assert physical accuracy; tighter analytic checks are independent diagnostics.

fname.meaning: Parsed TOA filename/site; original line and index are the stable identity, filenames can repeat.

site.meaning: Parsed TOA filename/site; original line and index are the stable identity, filenames can repeat.

deleted.meaning: Upstream flags from readTimfile; no selection or reordering is applied.

clockCorr.meaning: Upstream flags from readTimfile; no selection or reordering is applied.

delayCorr.meaning: Upstream flags from readTimfile; no selection or reordering is applied.

pulse_number.meaning: Signed int64 pulseN, decimal integer text; formResiduals phase count including integral F0*time term.

nphase_turn.meaning: Nearest integer of reduced phase5 after reference subtraction; not the full pulse count.

sat_mjd.initialization: readTimfile; modified only by declared perturbations
sat_mjd.meaning: Original or scenario-modified arrival epoch. For @ observations SAT is already barycentric TCB. For pks/7 terrestrial observations SAT is in the observatory clock realization; it is not TCB.

bat_mjd.meaning: Infinite-frequency solar-system barycentric arrival epoch, TCB in all declared fixtures. Observatory clock and propagation corrections transform terrestrial SAT to BAT; for @, BAT=SAT.

bbat_mjd.meaning: BAT minus secular-motion delay, TCB in all declared fixtures; equals BAT in the declared barycentric cases.

bat_correction_day.meaning: Combined clock and timing-delay correction; only present for delayCorr=1.

toa_error_us.meaning: Reported uncertainty, no fit or weighting applied.

frequency_ssb_hz.meaning: Barycentric observing frequency; omitted for @ where upstream has different units.

clock_tt_s.meaning: Sum of correctionsTT, accumulated upstream in binary64.

tt_tb_s.meaning: TT-to-TCB and TT-to-Teph offsets after observatory term.

tt_teph_s.meaning: TT-to-TCB and TT-to-Teph offsets after observatory term.

roemer_s.meaning: Geometric light time including active astrometric terms.

shapiro_sun_s.meaning: Signed Shapiro correction as stored, subtracted by formBats; individual terms need not be positive.

shapiro_jupiter_s.meaning: Signed Shapiro correction as stored, subtracted by formBats; individual terms need not be positive.

shapiro_saturn_s.meaning: Signed Shapiro correction as stored, subtracted by formBats; individual terms need not be positive.

shapiro_venus_s.meaning: Signed Shapiro correction as stored, subtracted by formBats; individual terms need not be positive.

shapiro_uranus_s.meaning: Signed Shapiro correction as stored, subtracted by formBats; individual terms need not be positive.

shapiro_neptune_s.meaning: Signed Shapiro correction as stored, subtracted by formBats; individual terms need not be positive.

troposphere_s.meaning: Stored atmospheric, interstellar DM and solar-wind delays, respectively, subtracted by formBats; signs preserved.

dispersion_s.meaning: Stored atmospheric, interstellar DM and solar-wind delays, respectively, subtracted by formBats; signs preserved.

solar_dispersion_s.meaning: Stored atmospheric, interstellar DM and solar-wind delays, respectively, subtracted by formBats; signs preserved.

shklovskii_s.meaning: Secular-motion contribution subtracted from BAT to get BBAT; zero here.

binary_delay_s.meaning: torb, zero for these isolated fixtures.

residual_s.meaning: Fixed-parameter residual; first eligible TOA fractional phase reference. No fit and no mean subtraction.

phase_turn.meaning: Full upstream phase after subtraction of first eligible TOA fractional phase. Absolute 1e-10 turns is <1ps at long-span F0 and 0.1ns at F0=1Hz.

earth_ssb_light_s_0.meaning: Cartesian components 0,1,2 of position vectors; upstream double, same equatorial barycentric axes.

earth_ssb_light_s_1.meaning: Cartesian components 0,1,2 of position vectors; upstream double, same equatorial barycentric axes.

earth_ssb_light_s_2.meaning: Cartesian components 0,1,2 of position vectors; upstream double, same equatorial barycentric axes.

observatory_earth_light_s_0.meaning: Cartesian components 0,1,2 of position vectors; upstream double, same equatorial barycentric axes.

observatory_earth_light_s_1.meaning: Cartesian components 0,1,2 of position vectors; upstream double, same equatorial barycentric axes.

observatory_earth_light_s_2.meaning: Cartesian components 0,1,2 of position vectors; upstream double, same equatorial barycentric axes.

clock_to_[0-9]+.meaning: Destination clock of each active correction in applied order.
clock_to_[0-9]+.gate_status: proposed terrestrial; unsupported in initial barycentric fixtures

clock_step_s_[0-9]+.gate_status: proposed terrestrial; unsupported in initial barycentric fixtures

flag_id_[0-9]+.meaning: TIM flag ID/value in original order (not supported in declared initial fixtures).
flag_id_[0-9]+.gate_status: proposed terrestrial; unsupported in initial barycentric fixtures

flag_value_[0-9]+.meaning: TIM flag ID/value in original order (not supported in declared initial fixtures).
flag_value_[0-9]+.gate_status: proposed terrestrial; unsupported in initial barycentric fixtures

reference_identity.description: Expected goldens must carry this correction plus instrumentation and build manifest hashes. Actual engines retain their own provenance.

engine_provenance: Engine build/compiler/dependencies, allocation/initialization policy, scenario name, resource paths/reads, diagnostic verbosity, legacy fit mode, diagnostic solar-wind sample count and parameter display labels are retained but excluded from scientific comparison. C need not fabricate them or read unused resources.

barycentric_projection.inactive_parameters: RAJ, DECJ, POSEPOCH, DM, DMEPOCH and TZR fields are explicitly preserved for these @ fixtures; EPHVER participates in the legacy units resolution. This projection does not enable their terrestrial calculations.
barycentric_projection.omittable_legacy_parameter_rule: If present, set=0, fit_flag=0 and value=0 are required. Any supplied higher derivative or TRACK is unsupported, even if zero.
barycentric_projection.omittable_zero_field_rule: If present these must be zero; NONE binary model and @ inputs are required. No synthetic zero fields required of C.
barycentric_projection.adapter_contract: C maps its owned input/result to this explicit projection, preserving original_observations exactly. For aligned/4ns stages it must evaluate the published stage epochs (and retain original input identity), implementing the declared perturbations in its test adapter. Unknown scientific fields/settings, unsupported supplied parameters, deleted TOAs and non-@ sites are rejected. This comparator checks fixture agreement, not completeness of a production input parser.

availability: Only available + barycentric-v1 is a comparison golden here. Corrected terrestrial-candidate and smoke-only profiles are refused, even if availability is relabeled. Failed results and schema-v1 uncorrected exports are refused.
